questions.question:
Complete the code to return both the generated answer and the retrieved context from a GraphRAG search:

from neo4j_graphrag.generation import GraphRAG

rag = GraphRAG(retriever=retriever, llm=llm)

response = rag.search(
	query_text="What is a knowledge graph?",
	-- select --
)

print(response.answer)
print(response.retriever_result)
